newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin eases marginally on lower London.
newsitem.headline: KL tin eases marginally on lower London.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed two cents lower at 14.29 ringgit ($5.77) a kg after a weaker London market kept most overseas buyers away.

Traders said the market saw an opening bid of 44 tonnes compared with offers of 87 tonnes. Final turnover was 58 tonnes, down from 81 tonnes on Monday. Buying at the lower levels was seen from Europe, Japan and locally.
A higher premium over the Londom market also discouraged buying, traders said. The local price differential to London rose to $65 a tonne premium from Monday's $10.
